lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Scoops

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I have something to tell you.
What is it?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: When I stopped by the Commander's Room a while ago,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: you had all sorts of bits and bobs

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: hanging precariously

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: at the edge of your desk:

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: a coffee cup, a plate, a desk lamp, and more.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It was making me antsy just looking at all of it.
So??

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I balanced it out.
What does that mean?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I used my paws to rearrange a few things

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: and bring a sense of balance back to your desk.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: The plate and desk lamp were all okay,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: but the coffee cup shattered.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It made a real racket,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: and gave me quite a fright, so I hurried out of there.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: By the time I fled all the way back to the shelter,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I figured the right thing to do

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: would be to let you know.
So the short version is, you broke my coffee cup.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I merely attempted to restore balance to your workspace.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: The cup broke itself.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Meow...

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I broke it.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Do you want me to come back and put everything back where it was?
No, I'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Okay, great.
But promise me one thing.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: What's that?
From now on, no matter how uncomfortable my desk arrangement makes you feel, leave it alone.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'd have to deny my feline instincts.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It's like when humans clean their rooms when they get too dirty.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: It's something you just do naturally.
What you've done is the opposite of cleaning.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Why would you think that?
After your "re-balancing" act, I've got to clean up the broken bits and stuff.
Nero doesn't reply for a while.
Yes?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: From the bottom of my heart.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: For making you clean up my mess.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: I'll try to exercise more restraint in the future.
Apology accepted.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Do I get a treat?
I'll think about it.
Sure. I'll give you some the next time you're here.
I should buy a reserve of kitty treats for the Commander's Room when I have time.
